book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Mpangu wa kunkamu Yesu
Chikahi cha uwangalalu wa kula mabumunda ghangakujeghaleka amila, jejilowakeka Uwangalalu wa Pasaka, ukabhi uheghalile.
Bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhabhola bha Shelia bhakabhi bhalonda indela ja kunkoma Yesu, nambu bhakabhajowipi bhandu.
Yuda ajetakela kung'anambuka Yesu
Bhela Shetani akunjingi Yuda, joalowakika Isikalioti, joakabhi jumu wa bhabhulwa komi na bhabheli.
Bhela Yuda akapiti kulongela nabhu bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhalonda bha Nyumba jaka Chapanga ntundu moang'anambukya Yesu kwabhu.
Bhakahekalili namaa na bhakajongini na Yuda kubha anabhumpekya mbija.
Yuda akajetakili na kutumbu kulonda mbekenyu jinyahi ja kung'anambuka Yesu kwabho, pandu ambapu njeta lipogha la bhandu.
Yesu aliandaa kula chilebhi cha Pasaka
Bhela lichobha la uwangalalu wa Mabumunda Ghangakujeghaleka Amila lakahikike, leniheli nde lichobha lelipalika mwanambeleli wa Pasaka kuchinjakika.
Bhela Yesu akabhatumiki Petulu na Yohana na kubhapwaghila, “Njendanya mkatuandalya chilebhi nahuli tukula Pasaka.”
Bhombi bhakundalukile, “Bho, upala tukakuandalya kwako?”
Yesu akabhayangiki, “Pamkajingala ku muchi, mkahimangana na mwanalomi joanyamwi chihulu cha machi. Mukunjengalyaje mbaka mu nyumba jeakajingalaje.
Mukumpwaghila mweni nyumba, ‘Mbola akulalukila, bho, kibhi kwa chumba cha bhagheni chenikula chilebhi cha Pasaka papamu na bhabhulwa bhango?’
Jombi anandangiya chumba chikolongwa cha kugholofa chekijomwi kubhekakeka wichu. Monihomu nde mkatuandalya chilebhe.”
Bhakapiti na kukihimani kila chindu kibhi wichu ngati Yesu moakapwaghile, na bhombi bhakaandi chilebhi cha Pasaka.
Chilebhi chaka Bambo
Chikahi pachahikaje, Yesu akatemi pahi, na kula chilebhi papamu na mitumi bhaki.
Akabhapwaghile, “Ndokuli namaa kula chilebhi chenu cha Pasaka papamu na mwenga mangane ja kung'ahika kwangu.
Chakaka numpwaghila, nganikuli kabheti chilebhi chenu cha Pasaka mbaka pajipitalya mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga.”
Bhela Yesu akachitoi chikombi cha divai, na kuchipengalela akapwagha, “Mtola chenjenu na ngabhana mabhokapi.
Maghambu numpwaghila kutumbu sajenu ngangunywi kabheti divai jenu mbaka Ukolongwa waka Chapanga pawihikaje.”
Kabheti akatohi libumunda, akunchengwi Chapanga, akalihekiti, na kubhapekeha, akapwaghaje, “Jenjenu nde hyegha jangu, jempatiki mwenga. Ntenda anana kwa kungomboka nepani.”

Bhelabhela paakajomwi kula chilebhi cha pakamihi akachitoi chikombi cha divai na kupwagha, “Chikombi chenjenu nde lulaghilu lwahenu lwaka Chapanga lolusibitishwa kwa mwahi wangu, ghoujitika kwa ndandi jinu.
“Nambu, ndingalyaje! Jola joaying'anambukaje akula chilebhi papamu na nepani.
Maghambu Mwana waka Mundu anaapotilaje ngati moapangi Chapanga, nambu anaachibhonaje mundu jola joang'anambukaje!”
Bhela bhakatumbwi kulaluhana bheni kwa bheni kubha nde nane pachilanda jabhu joanahenga lijambu leniheli.
Kulochana panani ja ukolongwa
Kukapitali kulochana kwa bhabhulwa kubhokana na nde nane joaholaleka kubha anaabya nkolongwa pachilanda jabhu kupeta bhangi bhokapi.
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Bhakolongwa bha bhandu bhanga Bhayahude bhabhajemale bhandu bhabhu kwa makile, na bhala bhabhabhi na lujiniku panani jabhu bhaliloha, ‘Bhakochi bha bhandu.’
Nambu ngakwikubha bhenibhela kwinu mabhanganya. Nambu jola joabhi nkolongwa pachilanda jinu, impalika abya ngati nchoku wa bhokapi, na joabhi chiongozi impalika abya ngati mtumika.
Bho, nane joabhi nkolongwa? Bho, jola joatama kula chilebhhi, au jola joabhatumakila? Chakaka nde jola joatama kula chilebhi. Nambu nepani mili pambane pachilanda jinu ngati mtumika.
“Mwenga nde mwemwahighali na nepani chikahi chokapi cha kulengakeka kwangu,
nepani numpekihi mwehapa ukolongwa, ngati Atati wangu moambeki nepani kubha nunkolongwa.
Nahuli mpata kula na kunywa pa meza jangu mu Ukolongwa wangu na kutama mu itehu ya kikolongwa kughatemula makabila komi na ghabheli gha Izilaeli.”
Yesu alota ngati Petulu anaankanaje
Yesu akapwaghiki, “Simoni, Simoni! Ujowanyaje! Shetani apala kumpeta mwehapa ngati ingano.
Nambu nepani nukulobhi wehapa wa Simoni, nahuli uhobhalelu waku ngawikepa, na wenga pawikelebhuka kwangu kabheti, wajangatya bhalongu bhaku.”
Petulu akamuyangiki, “Bambo, nepani nyetaki kujenda papamu na wehapa muchifungo, na hata kupotela!”
Yesu akamuyangiki, “Nukumpwaghi wehapa wa Petulu, lalenu mangane ja likongobhi kubheka wibya unganiki mala patatu kubha ngacheunimanye.”
Mbija, mfuku na lipanga
Bhela Yesu akabhalaluki bhabhulwa bhaki, “Panuntumiki panga mbija, wala nkoba, na wala magubasi, bho, mkakepakiwi na chindu bhole?” Bhakayangiki, “Ngachetwakepakiwi na chindu.”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Nambu henu, jola joabhi na mfuku wa mbija autolaje, na joabhi na nkoba autola bhelabhela. Na jokapi jwanga lipanga, alombisa ingobhu jaki na ahemala limu.

Maghambu numpwaghila, ipalika malobhi aghagha ghapitalya kwangu ngati moghalembakike mu Malembu Mahuhu, ‘Jombi akabhalangiki papamu na bhahenga mahakau.’ Chakaka ghala ghaghapalika kwangu ghapalika ghapitalyaje.”
Bhabhulwa bhakapwaghike, “Bambo! Lingalyaje, pambani ghabhi mapanga ghabhele!” Jombi akayangike, “Base iyaghanila.”
Yesu andobha Chapanga ku Chitombi cha Mizeituni
Yesu akabhokiki na kujenda ku Chitombi cha Mizeituni ngati mowabheli ntetu waki, na bhabhulwa bhaki bhakapiti papamu naku.
Paakahiki pandu panipala, akabhapwaghile, “Ndobhaje nahuli ngamwijingi mu malengakeku.”
Bhela mweni akabhokiki na kujenda pandu pa kuweza mundu kuleke liganga. Akachikimi, na kulobha,
akapwagha, “Atati, ngati anaupaliki, nukujopa umokiya kutali chikombi cha mang'ahiku. Ngakwikubha ngati mombali nepani, nambu kubya ngati moupali wehapa.”
Panihapa mtumika kuhuma kunani kwaka Chapanga akampitalili na kunjeghe makili.
Yesu akabhi mu mabhinilu makolongwa, akajonjuki kulobha nakanopi, na lihoghatela laki lakabhi ngati mandonyi gha mwahi, lelikaheli mbaka paluhombi.
Paakajomwi kulobha akakelawiki kwa bhabhulwa bhaki, akabhahimani bhaghochile, maghambu bhakabhi na huzune.
Akabhapwaghile, “Bho, mbona ngochile? Njumukaje na ndobhaje, nahuli ngamwijingi mu malengakeku.”
Yesu akamulika
Yesu paakabhi akali kulongela, lipogha la bhandu lakahikiki koni akalilonguwa Yuda, jumu wa bhabhulwa komi na bhabheli. Yuda akunjendi Yesu na kumbusu.
Nambu Yesu akundalukile, “Yuda! Bho, ung'anambuka Mwana waka Mundu kwa kumbusu?”
Bhabhulwa bhaka Yesu pabhaghaweni mambu ghaghipitalyaje bhakapwaghike, “Bambo, bho, twahekata le kwa mapanga?”
Jumu wabhu akundapwi lipanga mtumika waka Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa, na kunchekula likutu laki la kumalelelu.
Nambu Yesu akapwaghike, “Nkotukaje, ngamwihenga kabhete!” Akalikamwi likutu laka mundu jola na kundamiha.

Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghi bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa, na bhalonda bhakolongwa bha Nyumba jaka Chapanga, na bhazee bhabhahiki kunkamula, “Bho, muhikiki na mapanga na indonga kungamula ngati nepani nde mnyaghula?
Machobha ghokapi nakabhi na mwehapa pa Nyumba jaka Chapanga, na ngachemwangamwile. Nambu sajenu nde chikahi chinu, cha makili gha lubhendu kutawala.”
Petulu ankana Yesu
Bhela bhakunkamwi Yesu, na kumpeleka kunyumba jaka Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa. Nambu Petulu akabhi anjengale cha kutali.
Bhandu bhangi bhakapuliki motu pachilanda ja liwangala na kutama, na Petulu akahiki kunyatuki motu papamu nabhu.
Mtumika jumu wa chimbomba paambweni Petulu atami pambipi na motu, akundingalaki namaa na kupwagha, “Mundu ajoju najombi akabhi papamu na Yesu!”
Nambu Petulu akakaniki, akapwagha, “Mbomba, nepani ngachenummanyi!”
Palongi pachokope, mundu jongi akumbweni Petulu na kumpwaghila, “Wehapa nanau wa jumu wabho!” Nambu Petulu akayangike, “We mundu, nepani nga jumu wabho!”
Palapetiki lisaa limu, mundu jongi akajomalaki kwa kupwagha, “Chakaka mundu ajoju akabhi papamu naku, maghambu najombi nde mwenei wa ku Galilaya!”
Nambu Petulu akapwaghike, “We mundu, ngachemanyi malobhi ghaulongela.” Palapala paakabhi akali kulongela, likongobhi lakabhekike.
Bambo akang'anambwiki na kundingali Petulu. Na jombi Petulu akakombwiki malobhi ghala Bambo ghaampwagi, kubha, “Lalenu mangani ja kubheka likongobhe, wingana mala patatu kubha ngacheunimanyi.”
Petulu akapitiki kunja na kulela kwa kumbina mtima.
Yesu bhundongama na kulapulika
Bhandu bhala bhabhabhi bhundenda Yesu, bhakatumbwi kundongama na kundapula.
Bhakunhibhiki mihu kwa ingobhu na kundalukila, “Ulotilaje! Bho, akulapwi nane?”
Na bhombi bhakundongali malobhi ghangi ghamahele gha kuntondola.
Yesu bhumpeleka pachengo
Palukela, bhazee, bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhabhola bha Shelia bhakahimangini, na bhakumpeliki Yesu palongi ja pachengu jabhu.
Na bhombi bhakapwaghike, “Tupwaghilaje! Bho, wehapa le wa Kristo?” Nambu Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Hata ngati ananumpwaghile, ngamwihobhalele,
na hata ngati ananundaluki lilalukilu, ngamuniyange.
Nambu kutumbu sajenu, Mwana waka Mundu ayibya atami upambala wa kumalelelu waka Chapanga Mweni Makili.”
Bhela bhokapi bhakundalukile, “Bho, nde kupwagha kubha wehapa le wa Mwana waka Chapanga?” Na jombi akabhayangike, “Mwenga mpwagha chakaka kubha nepani nde jombi.”
Na bhombi bhakapwaghike, “Bho, tupala le mundu jongi ahikaje na atupwaghila ulandilu wake? Maghambu tepani tabhete tujowini akapwagha kwa ndomu waki mweni!”
